title: Resync table schema from scratch
description: Trigger a full resync for a table schema, discarding all previously synced data and re-importing from the source. This cancels any running sync first, then resets the pipeline state. Use this when data is corrupt or out of sync. To re-import on a recurring schedule, for example to remove rows deleted at the source from an incremental table, set full_refresh_interval_days with 'external-data-schemas-partial-update' instead of calling this repeatedly.

methodDocumentation.text: Request a full resync of the schema. For sources that can backfill, this drops the warehouse table and re-imports every row from the source, so existing data is deleted first. A webhook-only schema cannot backfill, so it keeps its existing table and resumes ingestion instead. To sync without requesting a rebuild, use reload.
